change_summary: Route only pure post-completion closing/pleasantry turns (no question, no decision, no pending tool work) to claude-haiku-4-5; all task-relevant turns keep the configured model.
reason_for_change: Every transcript ends with 1-2 zero-risk pleasantry turns (e.g. 'You're welcome, enjoy your boots'). These generate short but non-trivial output on the configured (potentially opus/sonnet) model. Strictly gating haiku to turns whose latest user message positively matches a closing signal, is short, contains no question/request/decision/confirmation tokens, and has no pending tool activity avoids the failure mode of prior haiku attempts (catching confirmation/decision turns). This lowers mean cost per task by cheapening the final farewell turns while leaving all task-relevant and verification turns untouched, holding the success floor.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — no cost improvement beyond noise: per-task cost 0.499110 >= threshold 0.448779 (best mean 0.479572 - 1σ·0.030793)
hypothesis: The default configured model is used for every turn including the many trivial closing/acknowledgement turns (e.g. 'You're welcome, enjoy your boots'); routing only the final farewell/no-tool-pending closing turns (turns where the user has already said no more needs) to claude-haiku-4-5 saves output tokens on cheap turns without touching any decision or verification logic.
